SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
